correctness.rationale: The exact Frobenius inner products reduce all pair distances to reciprocals of rectangle areas. Comparable pairs telescope into one-step increments and are minimized by the explicit discrete cubic maximum; the factored difference determines every tie. Incomparable pairs satisfy the rigorous 27/(4n^3) squared-distance lower bound, greater than the exact minimizer for n>=4. The n=3 exceptional crossing pair is computed directly. Exact rational replay checked 973896 pairs and 1386 direct-matrix comparisons, but finite enumeration is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The metric separation of canonical extreme Monge cost matrices is a natural sharp packing/resolution invariant with a concrete vertex-classification noise radius. The exact all-n solution distinguishes an unexpected crossing between the metric-cost face and its complement, includes all equality cases and a mod-three pattern, and scales as n^(-3/2); it is neither the previously known volume nor a combinatorial edge count. It does not claim a stronger approximation theorem for arbitrary matrix points.
